doc.description: SDP3X differential pressure sensor for e.g measuring airspeed.

define.name: SDP3X_I2C_ADDR
define.description: 8-bit I2C slave address (default: 0x42, corresponding to 7-bit address 0x21)

define.name: SDP3X_SYNC_SEND
define.description: send every acquired sample unfiltered; TRUE forces non-averaged sensor mode (default: FALSE)

define.name: SDP3X_MODE
define.description: continuous differential-pressure mode (default: averaged, or non-averaged when SDP3X_SYNC_SEND is TRUE)

define.name: SDP3X_PRESSURE_SCALE
define.description: optional pressure scale in counts/Pa; when omitted, use the CRC-checked scale reported by the sensor

define.name: SDP3X_VERIFY_PRESSURE_SCALE
define.description: when a pressure scale is configured, require the CRC-checked sensor scale to match before publishing (default: FALSE)

define.name: SDP3X_PRESSURE_OFFSET
define.description: pressure offset in Pa (default: set according to pressure range and output type according to datasheet)

define.name: SDP3X_DYNAMIC_PRESSURE_SWAPPED
define.description: set TRUE when the pitot port order makes forward airflow produce negative raw differential pressure (default: FALSE)

define.name: SDP3X_ENABLE_BIDIRECTIONAL
define.description: allow signed pressure and airspeed on ABI; when FALSE, clamp reverse pressure and ABI airspeed to zero (default: FALSE)

define.name: SDP3X_AIRSPEED_SCALE
define.description: quadratic scale factor 2/rho0 to convert Pa to squared equivalent airspeed in (m/s)^2

define.name: SDP3X_LOWPASS_TAU
define.description: Time constant for second order Butterworth low pass filter, cut-off freq of 1/(2*pi*tau) ~= 1Hz

define.name: USE_AIRSPEED_SDP3X
define.description: Set airspeed in state interface for this sensor
